F.A.Q

Common questions

What does "unlimited" really mean?

You can submit as many requests and revisions as you want at the same flat monthly price. The limit is design time, not the number of requests.

On Advanced and Business, our team spends up to 2 or 4 hours a day on your queue. On Assigned Designer and Design Team, your own designers work about 4 hours a day each on your account.

What's the turnaround time?

Turnaround time depends on the type and complexity of the project, the quality of the brief and the number of revisions needed.

First drafts arrive the next business day on Advanced and Business, and the same day on Assigned Designer and Design Team.

Bigger projects like brand identities, long decks or full websites take several days on any plan.

Do you use AI?

Yes, and you decide how much. Our designers have access to the best AI tools at no extra cost, and use them to explore ideas, create variations and work faster.

Want more AI in your designs, or none at all? Tell us and we'll follow it. A designer directs every piece either way.

How do you differ from a freelancer or agency?

Freelancers work on one-off projects. Agencies cost 3 to 10 times more and scope every project separately.

ManyPixels sits between the two: a dedicated designer or team plus a project manager, all for a flat monthly fee.

All our designers are full-time members of our team. We don't outsource any work.

Do I own the rights to the designs?

Yes. Everything we make is for you only. You own the files as soon as you receive them and can use them however you like.

Source files (Adobe, Figma, Canva) are always included, along with PNG, JPEG, SVG and PDF.

Can I cancel anytime? Any hidden fees?

Yes. Cancel anytime, with no fees. If you just need a break, pause for $10/month and keep access to your files.

There are no hidden fees: everything is included in the price.
